verdict.rationale: mParticle documents its own APIs across several surfaces: event ingestion, IDSync, the real-time profile API, a Platform API for Audiences, and the Warehouse Sync API. That shows meaningful programmatic coverage. The evidence does not show UI parity, though: connecting an audience to an output is documented as a UI flow (Data Platform > Setup > Directory), and most API entries are bare titles. Missing for 10: evidence of API coverage for all UI functions (connections/outputs, data quality plans, consent filters, feeds configuration), an explicit API-parity claim, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
